# Survey a research topic

Topic: Stateless agents for long-horizon research

This folder holds what this research campaign has learned so far. The harness writes it from its records and keeps it current. Every worker can read all of it; each lane writes only in its own working area, work/LANE/.

## Questions

Numbered from 1; a claim's or a hypothesis's `question` field takes the index, from 0.

- Question 1 (index 0): How much did the first run archive? (1 verified claims)
- Question 2 (index 1): What keeps a long campaign honest? (1 verified claims)

## What is here

- REPORT.md: the newest report (a digest, or the final report)
- sources/: 2 archived pages as text, one file each (claims quote these words)
- claims/: 3 claims, 2 verified and 1 drafts (the first line says which)
- findings/: 2 findings (1 supported)
- hypotheses/: 4 (2 that need a verdict, 0 in the pool)
- source-notes/: 1
- report/: 1 report sections
- cards/: one answer card for each question, whole with its earlier versions (cards/q0.md for question 1 (index 0), and so on); workers never edit them
- lanes/: the files each lane wrote, as they were when its last trial ended (2 files)

## Answer cards

The run's current answer to each question: the synthesizer writes each card from verified claims, and code checks it.

- Question 1 (index 0): cards/q0.md, certainty moderate (version 1), 0 open evidence gaps
- Question 2 (index 1): cards/q1.md, certainty moderate (version 1), 1 open evidence gaps

## Findings

- <f-supported> (supported): The harness kept its first run's pages.
- <f-draft> (draft): The first run was very large.

## Hypotheses

Only the author's hypotheses and promoted ones need a verdict from the review panel. The others are the run's pool, which the report lists as proposed by the run and no review waits on. Propose a hypothesis only when it is new; to change one of the pool's words, question or supporting claims, revise it (revise_hypothesis) instead of proposing it again.

- <h-author> (the author's, which needs a verdict; the whole run): Stateless workers make long runs safe.
- <h-pool> (promoted, which needs a verdict; Question 1 (index 0)): Archives outlive the workers that fill them.
- <h-twin> (merged into <h-pool>; Question 2 (index 1)): Archives outlive the workers that fill them.
- <h-idle> (retired; the whole run): Nobody reads the archive.

## Lanes' files

- lanes/lane-1/q0-synthesis.md (80 bytes, <at>)
- lanes/lane-1/weights.bin (4 bytes, <at>)
